description: The line plot illustrates the performance of various models in terms of Area Under the Curve (AUC) percentage as a function of the parameter N, which ranges from 0 to 20 on a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled AUC (%), spans from 75 to 100, with major tick marks at 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, and 100. Five distinct lines are plotted, each representing a different model configuration, identified by unique colors and markers: a blue line with circular markers, a brown line with square markers, an orange line with diamond markers, a green line with star markers, and a purple line with triangular markers. The blue line starts at approximately 94% AUC at N=0, rises to a peak of 98% at N=10, and then gradually declines to about 94% at N=20. The brown line begins at 87% AUC at N=0, increases to a peak of 98% at N=10, and then decreases to 91% at N=20. The orange line starts at 84% AUC at N=0, increases to a peak of 95% at N=15, and then slightly decreases to 94% at N=20. The green line begins at 86% AUC at N=0, increases to a peak of 94% at N=15, and then slightly decreases to 92% at N=20. The purple line starts at 79% AUC at N=0, increases to a peak of 96% at N=10, and then decreases to 82% at N=20.
